verdict.rationale: Shortwave's first-party blog says users can click "Add custom integration" and point the AI Assistant at any MCP server, including their own, and the pricing page lists MCP alongside built-in integrations. An independent security-vendor write-up also refers to Shortwave's MCP integration, which corroborates that the feature exists. Missing for 10: in-depth setup documentation (supported transports, authentication, tool permission/approval controls), hands-on user reports of connecting custom MCP servers.
